mapper.select: select definition.strategy_code as code, definition.id as definition_id, definition.version as definition_version, definition.name, definition.description, definition.strategy_type as type, version.id as version_id, version.version_no, version.parameter_schema::text as parameter_schema, version.evidence_schema::text as evidence_schema, version.change_summary, version.effective_from, version.source_factor_study_id, version.source_factor_set_version_id from cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_definition definition join cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_version version on version.strategy_definition_id = definition.id and version.status = 'ACTIVE' and version.deleted_at is null where definition.status = 'ACTIVE' and definition.deleted_at is null and version.effective_from <= current_date and (version.effective_to is null or version.effective_to >= current_date) order by definition.strategy_code asc, version.version_no desc

select definition.strategy_code as code, definition.id as definition_id, definition.version as definition_version, definition.name, definition.description, definition.strategy_type as type, version.id as version_id, version.version_no, version.parameter_schema::text as parameter_schema, version.evidence_schema::text as evidence_schema, version.change_summary, version.effective_from, version.source_factor_study_id, version.source_factor_set_version_id from cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_definition definition join cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_version version on version.strategy_definition_id = definition.id and version.status = 'ACTIVE' and version.deleted_at is null where definition.status = 'ACTIVE' and definition.deleted_at is null and version.effective_from <= current_date and (version.effective_to is null or version.effective_to >= current_date) and (definition.strategy_type = 'SCREENER_PRESET' or (definition.strategy_type = 'USER_SCREENER' and definition.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and definition.owner_id = #{ownerId})) order by case when definition.strategy_type = 'SCREENER_PRESET' then 0 else 1 end, definition.updated_at desc, definition.strategy_code asc, version.version_no desc
mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_definition (id, strategy_code, name, description, strategy_type, tenant_id, owner_id, status, version) values (#{strategy.definitionId}, #{strategy.code}, #{strategy.name}, #{strategy.description}, #{strategy.type}, #{tenantId}, #{ownerId}, 'ACTIVE', #{strategy.activeVersion.definitionVersion})

insert into cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_version (id, strategy_definition_id, version_no, status, parameter_schema, evidence_schema, change_summary, effective_from, source_factor_study_id, source_factor_set_version_id) values (#{strategy.activeVersion.id}, #{strategy.definitionId}, #{strategy.activeVersion.versionNo}, 'ACTIVE', cast(#{strategy.activeVersion.parameterSchema} as jsonb), cast(#{strategy.activeVersion.evidenceSchema} as jsonb), #{strategy.activeVersion.changeSummary}, #{strategy.activeVersion.effectiveFrom}, #{strategy.activeVersion.sourceFactorStudyId}, #{strategy.activeVersion.sourceFactorSetVersionId})
mapper.update: update cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_version set status = 'RETIRED', effective_to = current_date, updated_at = now() where strategy_definition_id = #{definitionId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and deleted_at is null
